uBu's Hiker's Hummus is made in small batches from great ingredients then freeze-dried. Just add water, mix, and enjoy. It can be reconstituted right in the pouch with cold water.

These are four-packs of Dayhiker Pouches (1.5 oz), which are designed as a snack for two or a more substantial serving for one.

Cilantro Lime

Cilantro lime hummus is a zesty and refreshing twist on classic hummus.

Everything Bagel

Filled with that delicious, peppery, onion-y flavor you've come to expect from Everything Bagels.

Roasted Garlic

Though this serves as our 'plain' flavor, it is not boring.

Ingredients

Chipotle

Ingredients: non-GMO Chickpeas, Water, Lemon Juice, Lime Juice, Garlic, Spice, Salt, Onion, Tomatoes, Chile Pepper.

Cilantro Lime

Ingredients: non-GMO Chickpeas, Water, Lime Juice, Cilantro, Garlic, Cumin, Salt, and Onion.

Roasted Garlic

Ingredients: non-GMO Chickpeas, water, lemon juice, garlic, salt, black pepper, cumin, and onion.

Thai Basil

Ingredients: non-GMO Chickpeas, Water, Lime Juice, Fresh Thai Basil, Garlic, and Salt.
